buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ​1. The vehicle tender is governed by the Service GCC, 2018 and all the terms and conditions stipulated th erein shall be applicable to the contract. 2. Actual delivery is to be done at ADEN office at DBRT required for use of ADEN/DBRT, Tinsukia Division. 3. Vehicle will be required for 24 (Twenty Four) months. 4. Working hours of vehicles will be 24 hours per day 7 days a week. Normal working hours will be from 7 :00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M. However vehicles can be called beyond this time also. Vehicle shall be kept reser ved with driver for 24 hours arrangement for calling of driver with vehicle within 30 Minutes from duty to be provided preferably by P&T telephone or keeping the driver at calling distance. Otherwise, Rs. 1000/- will be charged per instance and the same continued in 05 times, the tender will be terminated by the Railway. 5. The contractor shall abide by all statutory regulation like P.F scheme employees state insurance Act, L abour laws & minimum wages act etc. for driver/drivers. 6. If the vehicle driver is found under the influence of intoxicating substance Rs. 5,000/- per instance shall be deducted from the work done bill/ Performance Guarantee as penalty and the vehicle driver has to be taken off permanently. 7. For misbehaviour by the vehicle driver with Railway official Rs. 5,000/- per instance shall be deducted f rom the work done bill/ Performance Guarantee as penalty with staff being debarred permanently. 8. If the vehicle stops working while on duty for any reason whatsoever, a similar vehicle shall be provide d by the contractor within an hour, failing which penalty of Rs. 2,000/- per instance shall be deducted f rom the work done bill/ Performance Guarantee. 9. If the driver does not report in clean white uniform a penalty of Rs. 500/- may be levied. 10. Vehicle must be provided with clean seat cover, white towels, curtain, adequate foot mat, air freshene r etc. to satisfaction of user. (Which should be changed whenever they are dirty/damaged). 11. Distance in kilometer as per log-book maintained showing journey undertaken and distance travel ed. 12. Driver and concerned official shall sign logbook after completion of duty. 13. Contractor will have to maintain the vehicle at his own cost and Railway will pay no maintenance char ges. Contractor will have to make his own arrangement for garaging the vehicles. 14. Expert & experienced driver with valid license shall be provided with the vehicle. Vehicle should have all legal and valid documents along with tools, jacks, spare tyres and safety equipment including FA B ox etc. 15.Vehicle should have permit to run over entire state of ASSAM it is likely the vehicle any be taken out of Headquarter of concern vehicle using authority to other places on N.F. Railway Assam. In that situation , Contractor must ensure for driver to make their own arrangements for lodging boarding of self & gar aging of vehicle also liable for permit and other charges etc and Vehicle should have commercial regis tration. 16. It would be contractor's responsibility to pay and damages /compensation arising out of any accident o r theft of vehicle. Railway shall not reimburse any of such payment made by contractor. 17. In case the contractor fails to provide the vehicle for any day as per terms and condition a bove, a penalty of Rs.5000.00 shall be charged and the amount shall be deducted from the running bills/security deposit of the contractor. 18. Mandatory updation of labour data:- Mandatory updation of Labour data on Railway’s Shramik Kalyan p ortal by the bidder regarding payment of wages should be followed.

19. Successful bidder will have to submit EPF wages according to Shramik Kalyan Portal during claiming of bills, otherwise no bill will be processed. 20. Successful bidder will have to submit necessary vehicle documents like sale letter, Commercial Registr ation Certificate, Insurance, PUCC certificate etc. along with vehicle. . 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of FA & CAO, N. F. Railway, Maligaon payable at Tinsukia . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C FA & CAO, N. F. Railway, Maligaon . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 9. Forms of EMD and PBG

Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of FA & CAO, N. F. Railway, Maligaon payable at Tinsukia . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA & CAO, N. F. Railway, Maligaon A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
